# @tiavision/sinter-alloy

> Opinionated sinter components that need a script: `<alloy-sortable>` (reorder a list), `<alloy-board>` (cards within and between columns), each saving itself against one request shape; `<alloy-split>` (two panes); `<alloy-date>`, `<alloy-range>`, `<alloy-month>` (pickers in the page's language); `<alloy-palette>` (Ctrl+K); `<alloy-virtual>` (a long list over sinter's append pagination). Pointer and keyboard throughout. Built for temper (a required peer). Design of the rest (boards, pickers, command palette, long lists, split panes): docs/DESIGN.md.

Setup: `sinter({ libraries: ['@tiavision/sinter-alloy'] })`; `export * as alloy from '@tiavision/sinter-alloy'` in src/sinter.helpers.ts; `export type { Move, SortableText } from '@tiavision/sinter-alloy'` in src/sinter.types.ts; with temper's plugin add `node_modules/@tiavision/sinter-alloy/sinter/components` to `paths` (icons).

- `<alloy-sortable data-sn-with="{ items: tasks, keyOf: (t) => t.id, nameOf?: (t) => t.title, label, resource: 'tasks', save?: '/api/tasks/order', field?: 'rank', disabled?, quiet?, text? }">`: the usual form. `save` defaults to the resource's `src` + `/order` and `field` to its `order` (`-rank`: rank, descending) with sinter ≥0.23; with 0.22 `save` is needed and `field` defaults to `sort_order`. The resource has `order="<field>"`; a drop merges the item's field between its new neighbours' (optimistic layer of the page's store), then `PUT <save> { order: [every key, in order] }` (`save` a full URL), one request at a time; any 2xx; an answer that is the list or holds it (`{ tasks: [...] }`) has its field values applied by key; a failure rolls back, shows `text.failed` and emits cancelable `sort-error` `{ move, error }`. Server: renumber 0…n-1 in that order, idempotent.
- Another API shape: leave out `resource`/`save`, `data-sn-on-move="mv = $event.detail; run('save')"` with a fill `<x slot="item">` reading `$slot.item`, `$slot.index` (typed `any`: cast in a let, `data-sn-let="{ f: /** @type {Folder} */ ($slot.item) }"`). A drop emits `move` = `Move { key, from, to, after, before, via: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }` (cancelable: prevented, no save).
- Applying a move yourself: the resource has `order="<field>"`; a hidden action `<span hidden id="save" data-sn-put="/api/x/order" data-sn-when="mv" data-sn-body="{ ids: alloy.keysAfter(list, mv, (x) => x.id) }" data-sn-optimistic="merge(list.find((x) => x.id === mv.key), { rank: alloy.between(list, mv, 'rank') })">`. Check the request goes out in a built page: in caley, one `run()` target did nothing in the build though it worked in `render()`; at page level it works. Not yet explained: docs/DESIGN.md, S3. Items from state: `data-sn-on-move="names = alloy.reorder(names, $event.detail)"`.
- `<alloy-board data-sn-with="{ lists, listKey: (l) => l.id, listName?: (l) => l.title, items: cards, keyOf: (c) => c.id, nameOf?, group: 'status', label, resource: 'cards', save?: '/api/cards/order', field?: 'rank', disabled?, text? }">` with fills `slot="item"` ($slot.item, $slot.index, $slot.list) and `slot="list"` ($slot.list, $slot.count): a card's `group` field names its column. Saving: optimistic merge of the card's group and rank (`alloy.rankIn`), then `PUT <save> { group, order: [the target column's keys] }`; the server sets the group and renumbers that column. `move` is a BoardMove (Move + fromGroup, toGroup); cards in state: `cards = alloy.regroup(cards, $event.detail, (c) => c.id, 'status')`. Keys as the sortable's plus ArrowLeft/ArrowRight between columns.
- `<alloy-split data-sn-with="{ name?, initial, min, max, step?, label, controls?, direction?: 'row' | 'column', reverse? }">` with `<x slot="start">` and `<x slot="end">`: lays them out (a grid filling its box: give a column split a height), keeps the size in localStorage under `sn:alloy-split:<name>`; or `data-sn-model="state.width"` (value/change). Keys: arrows (Shift ×4), Home/End, Enter collapses/opens; double-click resets to initial. CSP: the first frame's size is a style attribute: `style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'`, else 30% until the module runs.
- `<alloy-date data-sn-model="d" data-sn-with="{ label, min?, max?, marks?, required?, placeholder?, text? }">`: ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`; shows `date(value, 'medium')`, reads typed dates in the page language's order; calendar popover. `<alloy-range data-sn-with="{ params?: ['start', 'end'], start, end, label, min?, max?, marks? }">`: with params writes the URL through navigate(); else handle `change` ({ start, end }, cancelable). `<alloy-month data-sn-model="m">`: `YYYY-MM`. Language: $locale, else the page's lang. Keys: arrows, PageUp/PageDown (Shift: year), Home/End, Enter, Escape; Alt+ArrowDown opens the date's.
- `<alloy-palette data-sn-with="{ label, src?, commands?: PaletteCommand[], keys?: false }">`: Ctrl/⌘+K; lists `nav a[href]` and buttons with `data-shortcut`/`aria-keyshortcuts`, plus `commands`, plus `GET <src>?q=` → `[{ id, label, href?, group?, keywords?, shortcut? }]`; picking follows href (navigate), clicks the button, or emits `pick`. Once per page (its list has a literal id).
- `<alloy-virtual data-sn-with="{ items, keyOf, label, total?, estimate?, overscan? }" data-sn-on-end="page(list, 'next')">` with `<x slot="item">` ($slot.item, $slot.index): renders the rows in view; the list is a resource with `paginate="{ append: { after: $item.id }, size: 100 }"`; give it a height. temper's `data-tm-lazy` first.
- Helpers: `reorder(list, move)`, `keysAfter(list, move, keyOf)`, `between(list, move, field)` (midpoint of the new neighbours' values, ±1 at the ends; equal neighbours: their value), `moved(list, move, keyOf)`; boards: `columnAfter(list, move, keyOf, group)`, `rankIn(list, move, keyOf, group, field)`, `regroup(list, move, keyOf, group)`.
- Keys: Space/Enter on the handle lifts, ArrowUp/Down/Home/End move, Space/Enter drops, Escape or Tab away cancels; announced in a live region; `text` (SortableText: handle(name), instructions, lifted/moved/dropped(name, position, total), cancelled(name, position), failed) for other languages.
- Tests: `render()` with the component's HTML as a component and its script in `scripts`; a script's state writes render on the next task (`await settle()`, or a `setTimeout(0)` then `flush()` while a request is held).
